title: Purchase evidence, before the answer
disclosure: LOCAL PORTFOLIO SANDBOX · SYNTHETIC DATA · SAVED SNAPSHOT

scenes.title: Which purchase patterns deserve a closer look?
scenes.body: A business question comes before a tool tour.
points: Proposed analysis, not an observed trend
Verify available dimensions and the purchase mart grain
scenes.notes: Use the evidence desk's clean audience window for the interactive version. Lead with the proposed purchase question, not a revenue or impact claim. The Lightdash project is not configured yet.
scenes.evidence: Choose a question supported by actual documented columns and a verified measure before recording a result.

scenes.title: Trace dependencies. Inspect the saved tables.
points: Wires are declared manifest lineage, not running event flow
Counts come only from completed read-only observations
Preview rows are bounded and unordered
scenes.notes: In the standalone dashboard, select the purchase spotlight. Click a model to inspect its table, then try another branch or the full graph. If the companion or snapshot is unavailable, show the honest unavailable state.
scenes.evidence: Actual API lineage IDs, snapshot labels, per-table observation timestamps, and observed counts. Do not quote prerecorded counts as current evidence.

scenes.title: Define the number before trusting it.
scenes.body: SQL and column contracts explain the analytical boundary.
points: Hover, focus, or pin a column contract
Declared tests are not test results
scenes.notes: Compare current worktree source with compiled manifest SQL. Explain the grain and aggregation actually present. Show owner/classification only as documented; otherwise say not documented. Read any missing-column or SQL-reference warning aloud.
scenes.evidence: Current SQL hash/time, loaded manifest hash, parsed YAML declarations, and actual snapshot schema comparison. No claim that source and snapshot are the same build.

scenes.title: Open a real business dashboard—or stop at setup.
scenes.body: A configured Lightdash destination is not a verified insight.
points: Verify login, project, warehouse connection, and metric definition
When setup is missing, show prerequisites—not a fake chart
scenes.notes: The Answer step intentionally has no result until the subject's Lightdash prerequisites are complete. If a real configured dashboard is available, open it in a new tab and verify its business question. External interactions are not synchronized by the evidence bridge; capture the actual external tab separately.
scenes.evidence: A real configured dashboard URL with no credentials or secret parameters, or the explicit missing-configuration panel.

scenes.title: Make the evidence boundaries visible.
scenes.body: Local, synthetic, saved evidence—not production impact.
points: Source SQL, manifest, docs, and saved database can differ
Dagster uses a separate runtime database; TCP reachability is not authenticated readiness
scenes.notes: Close on engineering judgment: the evidence is inspectable and its uncertainty is explicit. Starting Dagster or docs is a private confirmed operator action, never a slide or audience action. Do not run a build as part of this walkthrough.
scenes.evidence: Readable provenance and mismatch warnings. A clean audience capture with no notes, service-start controls, tokens, or private operator UI.
